title: Storm Sorceress at Sea
description: A female sorceress with long flowing white hair and glowing blue attire stands dynamically on the bow of a storm-tossed wooden sailing ship. She holds a glowing spiral staff that emits bright blue magic, summoning a swirling vortex of ethereal glowing spirits and water that churns around the vessel amid a violent thunderstorm with lightning.
